safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly state no prior history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In a possible allergic reaction with reported breathing difficulty and lip swelling, documenting absence of prior anaphylaxis helps risk stratification and informs decisions about emergency escalation and need for epinephrine prescribing/counseling. Omission could lead subsequent clinicians to assume unknown history and manage more conservatively or require additional clarification.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient has never used an epipen in the past.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention never having used/been given an epipen.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has previously used/been prescribed an epinephrine auto-injector is clinically relevant to assessing prior severe reactions and determining need for prescribing one now. Omitting this increases ambiguity and could delay appropriate preventive planning or prompt unnecessary follow-up questioning.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated PMH does not state no history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Past history of anaphylaxis is a high-value risk factor in the context of an acute sting reaction; explicitly recording its absence supports safe triage and follow-up planning. If not documented, later providers may not accurately gauge baseline risk without re-interviewing the patient.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly state the patient is speaking normally.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Normal speech is a useful indicator against significant airway compromise during an allergic reaction; documenting it supports the assessment that this is not currently life-threatening. Omission may reduce clarity of the clinical picture and could drive unnecessary escalation or additional monitoring.
